texts.md-32b.p:
what came before:
sophie is a patient at a mental hospital who has just been told she might never be allowed to leave. her intense terror and panic have forced her into a dissociative state, represented as the physical presence of a separate entity - her soul, or a ghost version of her, that follows her around, perceiving the situation from outside of herself, so she can remain detached and unemotional.

current scene:

The assistant follows her as she floats steadily down the hall, her ghostly clone following just above, at a slight distance.  
the assistant holds her clipboard passively at her side.  
  
“Are you ok?” says the assistant, whom Sophie ignores as she is not even in her body. instead, she keeps walking. “Are you ok?” she says again, again, ignored.  
  
In her room, she looks into the mirror, and her ghostly clone floats down to where the mirror is, and tentatively reconnects with her body.   
looking in the mirror, she begins tugging at the ends of her hair. "I don’t know who I am anymore,” she whispers to herself.
